name: I-Doll
source:
Main character joins an idol producer company to realize his old dream to make his childhood friend an idol. However, that childhood friend dies in an accident. He promises himself to realize some other girl's dream of becoming an idol instead.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
为了实现将青梅竹马培养成偶像的夙愿，主人公入职了一家偶像经纪公司。然而天意弄人，青梅竹马不幸在一场事故中香消玉殒。悲痛之余，他暗暗立誓，要将这份心愿托付给另一名怀揣偶像梦的少女，助她登上闪耀的舞台。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
